description: It will serve as an intelligence network to produce, disseminate and integrate data to address urban issues
body_lead: If a traffic congestion occurs around the 44-km busy Sarkhej-Gandhinagar highway connecting Ahmedabad and the state capital, simulated models using data on the route will help urban planners resolve it. The SG highway has around 10 flyovers and more are in the pipeline, all purported to ease traffic movement along the route. But collecting all this information is a tough task. These kinds of problems will now be fixed by an ‘urban observatory’ to be set up by the Gujarat government, in line with other major cities around the world.
